Aspect air

The relic grants you a fly Speed equal to your Speed or 60 feet, whichever is greater. In addition, a creature that Strikes you with a melee attack takes @Damage[5[electricity]] damage, and you can cast 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Lightning Bolt] as an innate spell.
